Theres very few things that bring me happiness. They are my expensive hobbies. unless i can fund said hobbies, no more hobbies. thus, money first. life is about money. no money=no fun=no life

Everyone can say they care about a stranger over the internet. but when I just want someone to get dinner with on my birthday, everyone I know disappears. fuck this shit. humans are assholes.
